#X3D V4.1 utf8 X_ITE V16.5.0

PROFILE Full

COMPONENT RigidBodyPhysics : 2

DEF RBC RigidBodyCollection {
  enabled FALSE
  preferAccuracy TRUE
  errorCorrection 0.5
  iterations 7
  gravity 1 -2 3
  constantForceMix 0.01
  maxCorrectionSpeed 2
  contactSurfaceThickness 0.05
  autoDisable TRUE
  disableTime 3
  disableLinearSpeed 0.1
  disableAngularSpeed 0.2
  visible FALSE
  bboxDisplay TRUE
  bboxSize 1 2 3
  bboxCenter 4 5 6
  collider DEF CC CollisionCollection {
    enabled FALSE
    appliedParameters [
      "BOUNCE",
      "FRICTION_COEFFICIENT_2",
      "SLIP_COEFFICIENT_2",
      "BOGUS"
    ]
    bounce 0.7
    minBounceSpeed 0.2
    frictionCoefficients 0.3 0.4
    surfaceSpeed 0.5 0.6
    slipFactors 0.7 0.8
    softnessConstantForceMix 0.02
    softnessErrorCorrection 0.3
    visible FALSE
    bboxDisplay TRUE
    bboxSize 1 1 1
    bboxCenter 1 1 1
    collidables [
      DEF A_O CollidableOffset {
        enabled FALSE
        translation 1 2 3
        rotation 0 1 0 1
        visible FALSE
        bboxDisplay TRUE
        bboxSize 1 1 1
        bboxCenter 2 2 2
        collidable DEF A_C CollidableShape {
          enabled FALSE
          translation 3 2 1
          rotation 1 0 0 1
          visible FALSE
          bboxDisplay TRUE
          bboxSize 1 1 1
          bboxCenter 1 2 3
          shape Shape {
            geometry Box { }
          }
        }
      }
      DEF SP CollisionSpace {
        enabled FALSE
        useGeometry TRUE
        visible FALSE
        bboxDisplay TRUE
        bboxSize 1 2 3
        bboxCenter 4 5 6
        collidables USE A_C
      }
    ]
  }
  bodies DEF A RigidBody {
    enabled FALSE
    fixed TRUE
    position 1 2 3
    orientation 0 1 0 1
    linearVelocity 1 2 3
    angularVelocity 4 5 6
    useFiniteRotation TRUE
    finiteRotationAxis 1 0 0
    autoDamp TRUE
    linearDampingFactor 0.1
    angularDampingFactor 0.2
    mass 3
    centerOfMass 1 1 1
    inertia 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9
    useGlobalGravity FALSE
    forces 1 1 1
    torques 2 2 2
    autoDisable TRUE
    disableTime 4
    disableLinearSpeed 0.3
    disableAngularSpeed 0.4
    bboxDisplay TRUE
    bboxSize 2 2 2
    bboxCenter 3 3 3
    geometry USE A_O
  }
  joints [
    DEF J1 BallJoint {
      forceOutput "body1AnchorPoint"
      anchorPoint 1 2 3
      body1 USE A
    }
    DEF J2 SingleAxisHingeJoint {
      forceOutput "ALL"
      anchorPoint 1 2 3
      axis 1 1 0
      minAngle -1
      maxAngle 2
      stopBounce 0.1
      stopErrorCorrection 0.2
      body2 USE A
    }
    DEF J3 DoubleAxisHingeJoint {
      forceOutput "ALL"
      anchorPoint 1 2 3
      axis1 0 0 1
      axis2 1 0 0
      minAngle1 -1
      maxAngle1 1
      desiredAngularVelocity1 1
      desiredAngularVelocity2 2
      maxTorque1 3
      maxTorque2 4
      stop1Bounce 0.1
      stop1ConstantForceMix 0.2
      stop1ErrorCorrection 0.3
      suspensionForce 0.4
      suspensionErrorCorrection 0.5
    }
    DEF J4 SliderJoint {
      forceOutput "separation"
      axis 1 0 0
      minSeparation -1
      maxSeparation 2
      sliderForce 3
      stopBounce 0.1
      stopErrorCorrection 0.2
    }
    DEF J5 UniversalJoint {
      forceOutput "ALL"
      anchorPoint 1 2 3
      axis1 0 1 0
      axis2 0 0 1
      stop1Bounce 0.1
      stop2Bounce 0.2
      stop1ErrorCorrection 0.3
      stop2ErrorCorrection 0.4
    }
    DEF J6 MotorJoint {
      autoCalc TRUE
      forceOutput "ALL"
      axis1Angle 1
      axis2Angle 2
      axis3Angle 3
      axis1Torque 4
      axis2Torque 5
      axis3Torque 6
      enabledAxes 3
      motor1Axis 0 1 0
      motor2Axis 0 0 1
      motor3Axis 1 0 0
      stop1Bounce 0.1
      stop2Bounce 0.2
      stop3Bounce 0.3
      stop1ErrorCorrection 0.4
      stop2ErrorCorrection 0.5
      stop3ErrorCorrection 0.6
    }
  ]
}

USE SP

DEF S CollisionSensor {
  description "d"
  enabled FALSE
  collider USE CC
}
